title: Export capacity is 49.9 MW in two documents and 45 MW in the grid offer
why: Revenue modelled on 49.9 MW may be overstated by about 10% if the grid only accepts 45 MW.
how: Three documents give different figures for the same thing. Rather than pick one, we show all three and ask you to decide. If they turn out to describe different limits, correct the result and your reason is kept for future runs.

citation.quote: with a maximum export capacity of 49.9MW

evidence.heading: Description of development
evidence.paragraph_text: Installation of a ground-mounted solar photovoltaic array and battery energy storage system with a maximum export capacity of 49.9MW, together with associated infrastructure.

evidence.heading: Schedule 1: Facility
evidence.paragraph_text: Contracted Capacity: 49.9 MW (AC), measured at the Delivery Point.

citation.quote: The Maximum Export Capacity at the Point of Connection shall be 45 MW

evidence.heading: 4. Connection
evidence.paragraph_text: The Maximum Export Capacity at the Point of Connection shall be 45 MW. The Connection Date shall be 1 October 2029, subject to completion of Reinforcement Works at Wickham Primary Substation.
